description: did:webvh logs generated by the independent didwebvh-ts implementation (tools/external/didwebvh-ts.ts). Keys are random per run, so regenerating changes every byte. The harness's `external` suite checks each entry's SCID, entry hash, proofs, pre-rotation key hashes and witness proofs with every implementation.

scenarios.name: prerotation

scenarios.name: witnessed
